titre: Un parc automobile américain toujours plus vieux
sous_titre: Âge moyen des voitures et véhicules légers en circulation aux États-Unis, en années, 2023 à 2025

2023.texte: the average age of cars and light trucks in the US has risen again this year to a new record of 12.5 years

2024.texte: The average age of cars and light trucks in the U.S. has risen again to a new record of 12.6 years in 2024

2025.texte: The average age of U.S. light vehicles rose to 12.8 years, an increase of two months for the second consecutive year
